title: salvia officinalis var. approximata
intro: Salvia officinalis var. approximata, commonly known as the American sage, is a variant of the sage plant, native to North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of American sage include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of American sage include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, including camphor, borneol, and thujone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
